patterns.label: Cold open
patterns.detail: First line carries the post: 'BREAKING: Google just proved AI data centers in space actually work' (1.48M), '5 weeks in an Opus 5.5 is still the goat' (41.4k), 'This is a crazy FSD mistake' (34.1k), 'are you building something?' (34.4k). Detail comes after the line break.

patterns.label: Numbered stack / stat block
patterns.detail: Dated count lists and bullet stacks: Texas Robotaxi fleet 42 to 1,204 since May (14.8k), 'Things you don't need to worry about when buying a Tesla' bullets (26k), Claude Ultra vs Max plan breakdown (38.6k), ns123abc's greentext S-1 numbers (64.6k), testingcatalog's Daily AI Brief.

patterns.label: Named tools and things
patterns.detail: Project Suncatcher, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Ultra, gpt-6-astra-law, Codex resets, Antigravity cloud execution, GLM-5.5, Grok Bot stable release, Macroharder and Minihard, Optimus factory, Cybercab, Robotaxi, Trump Accounts.

patterns.label: Opinion on a quote
patterns.detail: 16 of 44 hits quote someone and add a take: Shotwell's SpaceX stock gift (52.2k), Claude plan confusion (38.6k), DirtyTesLa on a crazy FSD mistake (34.1k), Anthropic weights leak take (27.2k).

patterns.label: Soft CTA / participation ask
patterns.detail: tibo_maker's 'drop your link + a one sentence pitch' got 34.4k on a Saturday morning. Questions and 'drop yours below' asks keep pulling replies when the reward is attention.

patterns.label: Owned firsthand content
patterns.detail: Own footage and own driving: JoeTegtmeyer's 7-month Optimus factory time-lapse (34.7k), DirtyTesLa's Michigan FSD take and app screenshot (13.6k), RGVaerialphotos riding along (6.1k). Halloween memes did 14.6k for niccruzpatane.

patterns.detail: Two clusters: Fri 11 AM to 4 PM PT (Suncatcher 12:13 PM, Shotwell gift 2:44 PM, Altman math 3:46 PM, Optimus time-lapse 3:51 PM) and Sat 6 AM to 9 AM PT (Opus 5.5 8:24 AM, FSD mistake 8:34 AM, Tesla checklist 7:48 AM, tibo's link drop 3:30 AM).

virals_narrative: Outsider AI meta (last ~48h): Anthropic drama drives the biggest small-account wins. A 365-follower researcher's 'I never distilled Claude' post hit 72.6k, and Fable 5.5 leak and countdown posts keep travelling (25k from 17k followers, 19.1k and 5.3k from 10.7k followers, 16.3k from 3.2k followers). Model face-offs work too (Gemini 4 Carbon vs Opus 5.5 at 11.6k from 1.3k followers). Builder posts still pay: 'Introducing Rex Claude', a Claude Code skill, did 13.5k, and a free-courses list for learning Claude did 5.3k. Opinion takes with a villain land as well: 'Sam Altman just told you local inference is terrible' (10k) and an October roundup of Chinese open-weight models (9.8k). A space-infrastructure investor rode the Suncatcher news to 12k from 341 followers. Filtered out: watchlist accounts, news and market wires (Wall St Engine, The Daily Block), a crypto token promo, and one likely boosted post (95k views on 0 likes). X search only surfaced 13 posts that cleared every filter, short of the 20 target.

drop your link + one sentence pitch
pattern_brief: The day belonged to space compute and Anthropic. ns123abc's 'Google just proved AI data centers in space actually work' (Project Suncatcher) hit 1.48M views, and his S-1 greentext did 64.6k. Anthropic plan changes (Claude Ultra, 38.6k and 34.5k) and kimmonismus' 'Opus 5.5 is still the goat' (41.4k) kept the model talk going. On the Tesla and SpaceX side: Shotwell's SpaceX stock gift to kids (52.2k), the Optimus factory time-lapse (34.7k), a 'crazy FSD mistake' quote (34.1k), and Robotaxi fleet counts (14.8k and 12.6k). What works: a one-line cold open with a named thing, dated count lists, a clear take on someone else's post, and owned footage. tibo_maker's 'drop your link' ask shows a cheap participation post still pulls on a weekend. For Jose: you had no posts in the last day, so today's target is open. Best fits for your lane are the SpaceX stock angle (you hold SpaceX) or the 'things I stopped doing after buying a Tesla' list with your 9 years inside, posted before 3 PM PT. A Grok Bot build-in-public post riding the stable release is a solid second.
